W_R_E_RELATION.operational_rule: Remove the credential as soon as the governed work completes, and never later than the earlier of R and E.

ORDERING.rule: SCHEDULE_BEFORE_CERTIFICATION. This schedule is inside the certified package (docs/ops/release/FIBDB053_D1_* is in the package closure). The candidate that is independently certified already carries the schedule that will be executed. No schedule write is required, or permitted, between the certification event and N11.
ORDERING.a_later_schedule_change: Makes HEAD differ from the certified candidate by more than the event: N10 NOT_READY until a NEW candidate carrying the new schedule is certified (termination regression, case C 'a schedule change after certification').
ORDERING.why: Both earlier next_gate texts put 'fresh schedule -> owner N08/N31 -> mechanical N09' AFTER the certification PASS. That sequence cannot terminate: the schedule write would invalidate the event it follows. Those records are append-only and are not edited; this record supersedes their ordering.

SCHEDULE_SAFETY.it_authorizes_nothing: A future N08 instant defines the schedule and the validity window. It does not authorize any credential-sensitive act, and wall-clock time is never a reason to mint.
